title: Camo Trucker Cap
body_html:
The loudest cap in the lineup — black crown, camo brim, no apologies.

  • Black crown with camo-print brim for a rugged, statement two-tone look
  • Bold white "PARmore" wordmark and "no membership required" tag, motorsport branding family
  • Structured 5-panel construction with a curved brim

The camo brim takes this one out of classic-trucker territory and into streetwear/outdoor crossover — a bolder pick for anyone who wants the cap to do some of the talking.

Fabric - 100% cotton body. 55% cotton, 45% polyester peak
Fit - Structured 5-panel, curved brim Snapback fasten
Best worn - Anywhere and everywhere. You do you.

title: Graphic Tee - Drop-Shoulder Cotton Tee
body_html:
A 240gsm Faded Bone cotton tee that doesn't try too hard, yet shows itself off.

Off-White body with navy "Parmore" wordmark and "no membership required" tag centered on the chest

  • Small flag-mark and dot-cluster graphic detailing for a sporty, athletic look
  • Slightly oversized, drop-shoulder silhouette with a crew neck

This is the everyday tee of the range — Drop-shoulder cut with a crew neck that's built to be worn loose rather than fitted. The chest graphics keep it in that sporty-athletic lane without going full performance-wear.

Fabric - 100% Cotton. 
Fit - Boxy, relaxed fit with a drop-shoulder.
Best worn - Off-course streetwear lean; casual enough to wear wherever you go.

title: Motorsport Tee – Racing Graphic Tee
body_html:
Fast graphics, easy fit - the motorsport tee that keeps things simple.

  • Black body with small red italic "PARmore" racing-style wordmark and "no membership required" tag, centered chest
  • Part of the motorsport branding family, shared with Cap 1 and the Zipped Hoodie
  • Boxy, drop-shoulder silhouette with a crew neck

The most understated of the motorsport-family pieces - a small Red racing-style wordmark on a plain black body. 

Fabric - Heavyweight 100% Cotton. 240gsm.
Fit - Sightly baggier. Can size up or down. 
Best worn - Casual, Minimal streetwear

title: Minimal Tee -  Everyday Cotton Tee
body_html:
The quiet one - a single small script and nothing else, so it works wherever you're headed.

  • White body with a small navy Parmore logo on left chest.
  • The most minimal branding of the tee range - no back print, no tags
  • Boxy, drop-shoulder silhouette with a crew neck

Where the other tees lead with graphics, this one leads with restraint — a single small logo on the left chest and nothing competing for attention.

Fabric - Heavy faded 240gsm 100% cotton
Fit - Slightly boxy fit. Baggier around the arms and chest.
Best worn - Works where you need it to.

title: Graphic Hoodie - Motorsport print
body_html:
The layer for when it's too cold for a quarter-zip but you're not done for the day.

  • Black body with a red italic "parmore" wordmark centered chest — motorsport branding family, matches Tee 3 and Cap 1
  • Boxy drop shoulder fit with a kangaroo pocket and drawstring hood
  • Ribbed cuffs and hem. Anti-pill CVC fleece lined inner.

A relaxed hoodie built primarily as an off-course layer, though the weight and coverage mean it could double as a cold-morning throw-on before or after a round.

Fabric - 350gsm 80% Cotton. 
Fit - Relaxed, boxy fit. 
Best worn - Off-course primarily; could layer on-course in cold

title: Graphic Tee - No Membership Required (White)
body_html:
This is the "No Membership Required" message at its loudest. The front is a sunlit, anything-goes moment on the fairway, with the slogan in Parmore lime printed straight across the photo. It's a nod to the idea that the game belongs to whoever turns up, not whoever paid the joining fee.

Under the print is a heavyweight 240gsm tee in faded white. It's cut boxy with dropped shoulders, so it sits relaxed rather than fitted. Wear it for a casual round, to the pub afterwards, or anywhere else.

Fabric - 240gsm heavyweight jersey, faded white.
Fit - Boxy and slightly oversized, with dropped shoulders.
Best worn - Off the course as streetwear, and relaxed enough for a casual round

title: Parmore Ball Marker
body_html:
Mark your ball with the Parmore Box Logo ball marker.

11.4 H x 31.75 W - Nickel plated with raised printed Parmore logo.

title: Parmore + Ripstop Cotton 5 panel
body_html:
This is the cross mark as a cap. It's the same "+" symbol that runs through some other items in the range, finished in raised 3D embroidery so it stands off the front panel. The Parmore wordmark on the side finishes it off.

The crown is ripstop cotton blend in warm charcoal, a softer shade than black that goes with pretty much anything. The shorter brim keeps the look sharp and streetwear-led, and it's just as practical over a full round. Sweat it out on the back nine, then wear it everywhere else.

Fabric: ripstop cotton blend.

Construction: 5-panel crown, shorter curved brim, stitched eyelets, 3D embroidered front logo, flat embroidered side wordmark.                                                                               

Fit: one size, with a velcro strap.

title: Cargo Pants – Paneled Utility Pant
body_html:
A street cargo pant that happens to wear the Parmore name - not one for the course and not one for your scorecard in the back pocket (there is none).

  • Black body with subtle tonal panel blocking at the yoke
  • "Parmore" wordmark printed on the right thigh cargo pocket
  • Elasticated waist with cargo side pockets, tapered leg and toggle-cinched ankle hem

This one's built as a street cargo pant, not a golf trouser - the tapered leg and toggle-cinched ankle give it a fashion-forward silhouette, and the tonal panel blocking adds just enough detail without shouting.

Fabric - Nylon and 
Fit - Baggy tapered leg, elasticated waist, Drawstring hem for optional fit. 
Best worn - Off-course casual, driving range - a street cargo pant, not a golf trouser?

title: Stripe Polo – Brown & Cream
body_html:
The warmer colourway of our stripe polo — same relaxed shape, same clean capsule branding.

  • Brown and cream horizontal stripes with a solid brown contrast collar and cuffs
  • White "+" cross-mark left chest plus a small "Parmore" text on the left cuff — same capsule family as the Green Stripes Polo
  • Relaxed fit with a classic three-button placket and wider sleeve area.
  • 240 GSM - Perfect for rounds in all seasons.

The brown/cream colourway of our stripe polo, built on the same relaxed, boxy three-button shape, with an extra small wordmark on the cuff for a bit more branding detail than the green version.

Fabric - Cotton/Poly blend. Offers a 4 way stretch. 
FitRelaxed, boxy - Regular fit. 
Best worn - Classic on-course polo shape.

title: Stripe Polo – Olive & White
body_html:
The warmer colourway of our stripe polo -same relaxed shape, same clean capsule branding.

  • Olive and cream horizontal stripes with a solid brown contrast collar and cuffs
  • White "+" cross-mark left chest plus a small "Parmore" text on the left cuff - same capsule family as the Brown Stripes Polo
  • Relaxed fit with a classic three-button placket and wider sleeve area.
  • 240 GSM - Perfect for warm and cold rounds. 

The olive/cream colourway of our stripe polo, built on the same relaxed, boxy three-button shape, with an extra small word mark on the cuff for a bit more branding detail than the green version.

Fabric - Cotton/Poly blend. Offers a 4 way stretch. 
FitRelaxed, boxy - Regular fit. 
Best worn - Classic on-course polo shape.

title: Tie-Dye Hooded Jacket – Full Zip Shell
Camo Quarter-Zip – Statement Pullover
body_html:
The boldest piece in the range — camo print, arched wordmark, no subtlety.

  • Realistic hunting-style camo print in browns, tans and greens
  • Large bold white collegiate arched "PARMORE" wordmark in embroidered print block letters, centered chest
  • Relaxed quarter-zip pullover fit with stand collar

This is the statement piece of the range — the Real Tree camo print and oversized patch-print word mark are built to be noticed, sitting closer to streetwear/hunting-lifestyle crossover territory than traditional golf outerwear.

Fabric - Nylon/Spandex/Cotton
Fit - Relaxed quarter-zip. Fits true to size
Best worn - Layer it as you wish. The boldest, most statement piece in the range

title: Capsule Windbreaker – Long Sleeve Pullover
body_html:
Clean, technical, and built to move - the wind layer for when style still matters.

  • Khaki/stone body with cream ribbed collar, cuffs and hem trim
  • White "+" cross-mark left chest - shared capsule symbol with the quarter-zip and striped polos
  • Parmore word mark screen printed on the rear.
  • Relaxed pullover fit with raglan sleeves, white piping seam detail, zip hand pockets and drawcord hem. Finished with a mesh liner for added protection. 

The piped raglan seams and zip hand pockets put this one firmly in technical-wear territory rather than fashion windbreaker - it's built to be worn during the round, not just after it.

Fabric - Nylon spandex mix. Mesh lined.
Fit - Relaxed pullover, raglan sleeve - Size down for a closer fit. 
Best worn - On-course wind layer, technical styling.

title: Paneled Tee – Cotton Jersey Tee (Grey)
body_html:
Same jersey build as our red paneled tee, in a charcoal that's easier to keep clean off the course too.

  • Charcoal grey body with white side-panel inserts, same cut as the Red Paneled Tee
  • Small silicone printed "Parmore" wordmark centered chest
  • Regular fit with raglan sleeve seams

The charcoal colourway of our red paneled tee, built on the same raglan-seam, contrast-panel construction - a retro sports-jersey silhouette that reads athletic and holds up on-course.

Fabric - Pique Cotton.
Fit - True to size, regular fit. 
Best worn - Its good for all occasions.

title: Paneled Tee – Cotton Jersey Tee (Red)
body_html:
Same jersey build as our grey paneled tee, in a charcoal that's easier to keep clean off the course too.

  • Cardinal red body with white side-panel inserts, same cut as the Red Paneled Tee
  • Small silicone printed "Parmore" wordmark centered chest
  • Regular fit with raglan sleeve seams

The red colourway of our grey paneled tee, built on the same raglan-seam, contrast-panel construction - a retro sports-jersey silhouette that reads athletic and holds up on-course.

Fabric - Pique Cotton.
Fit - True to size, regular fit. 
Best worn - Its good for all occasions.

title: Colourblock Swing Shirt - Zip layer
body_html:
The layer you reach for when the forecast can't make up its mind — light enough for the back nine, sharp enough to keep on after.

  • Colourblock design in Coffee Liqueur brown and Beluga grey-olive
  • Full zip closure with zip-lined front pockets
  • Short sleeves with a relaxed, baggy fit for unrestricted movement
  • Drawstring adjustment at the hem to dial in the fit or block out wind
  • Parmore logo DTF printed front and back

Built as a short-sleeve swing shirt rather than a full jacket, this one's designed to go on and stay on. The zip-lined front pockets mean you're not choosing between pockets and a clean layering silhouette, and the drawstring hem lets you cinch it down when the wind picks up or let it hang loose off the course.

Fabric - Polyester & fibre composite. 
Fit - Relaxed, baggy fit through the body, true to size.
Best worn - On-course layering piece; easy transition off-course

title: Varsity Quarter-Zip – Weatherproof Pullover
body_html:
A wind and water resistant layer with heritage stripe detailing that doesn't skip the technical bits.

  • Forest/bottle green body with cream ribbed varsity stripe trim at collar and cuffs
  • White "Parmore" silicone printed wordmark on the chest, white "+" cross-mark on the upper back - shared capsule symbol with the striped polos and long-sleeve windbreaker
  • Relaxed quarter-zip pullover fit with kangaroo pocket, drawcord hem, mesh-vented lower back yoke and white side-seam panel inserts
  • Ready for whatever ready - Water repellant outer with mesh liner and ventilated sections. 

Built as a genuine wind layer rather than a fashion quarter-zip: the mesh-vented back yoke and side-seam panel inserts are functional details, not just styling, and the drawcord hem lets you seal it against gusts mid-round.

The cream varsity stripe trim ties it to the heritage side of the range without losing the technical construction underneath - this one works as hard on-course as it looks off it. 

Fabric - Woven Cotton ribbing with Nylon outer. Waterproof zip line.
Fit - Relaxed quarter-zip with drawstring.
Best worn - On-course wind layer; varsity styling also works off-course

title: ACTIVE GRIP SOCKS
body_html:
The sock that doesn't move once you've committed to the swing — grippy soles, snug fit, done.

  • Rubber grippers on the sole for added traction and support through the swing
  • Elasticated, supportive knit that stays put — no chasing these back up your ankle
  • Mid-length cut, one size fits all
  • Parmore logo knitted into the design, not printed
  • 85% nylon, 10% polyester, 5% spandex for stretch and durability

Grip socks solve one problem: the slide. The rubber sole grippers keep your foot locked in place inside the shoe through the swing, and the elasticated nylon-spandex knit means the sock itself stays exactly where you put it — no mid-round pull-ups.

Mid-length and one-size, they're built to go under any golf shoe without adding bulk, with the Parmore logo knitted in rather than printed on for something that'll outlast the season.

Fabric: 85% nylon, 10% polyester, 5% spandex
Fit: One size fits all, mid-length
Detail: Rubber sole grippers, knitted logo
